verses.1: Alleluia. Praise the Lord, because the psalm is good. Delightful and beautiful praise shall be for our God.
verses.2: The Lord builds up Jerusalem. He will gather together the dispersed of Israel.
verses.3: He heals the contrite of heart, and he binds up their sorrows.
verses.4: He numbers the multitude of the stars, and he calls them all by their names.
verses.5: Great is our Lord, and great is his virtue. And of his wisdom, there is no number.
verses.6: The Lord lifts up the meek, but he brings down the sinner, even to the ground.
verses.7: Sing before the Lord with confession. Play psalms to our God on a stringed instrument.
verses.8: He covers heaven with clouds, and he prepares rain for the earth. He produces grass on the mountains and herbs for the service of men.
verses.9: He gives their food to beasts of burden and to young ravens that call upon him.
verses.10: He will not have good will for the strength of the horse, nor will he be well pleased with the legs of a man.
verses.11: The Lord is well pleased with those who fear him and with those who hope in his mercy. [ Psalm 147 ] (147B)
